title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 2.2 Evaluate, Simplify, and Translate Expressions: Evaluate algebraic expressions
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 2.2 Evaluate, Simplify, and Translate Expressions: Evaluate algebraic expressions
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "2.2 Evaluate, Simplify, and Translate Expressions", prints these objectives: "Evaluate algebraic expressions" "Identify terms, coefficients, and like terms" "Simplify expressions by combining like terms" "Translate word phrases to algebraic expressions". The section text says: "In the last section, we simplified expressions using the order of operations. In this section, we’ll evaluate expressions—again following the order of operations." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
